title: 業務用コンベクションオーブン
description: 食堂やベーカリー厨房の作業位置へ置く対流式オーブン外観。開いた加熱室、二段の実ワイヤー棚、奥の固定ファンとガード、横に開いた扉と引手、つまみ・無表示パネル、裏点検部と調整足を造形。扉の青灰色窓は不透明な単色PBR表現です。台・食品・トレーは含まず、加熱・送風・開閉操作は実装していません。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）1.048 × 0.877 × 1.409 m、17,628三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: A convection-oven appearance prop for cafeteria and bakery work areas. An open chamber contains two real wire shelves and a fixed rear fan/guard, with swung-open door/pull, knobs, inactive display, rear service features and leveling feet. The blue-gray door window is an opaque constant-color PBR substitute. Counter, food and trays are absent; heating, airflow and door operation are not implemented. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 1.048 × 0.877 × 1.409 m; 17,628 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or wall-mount pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Xenoah
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
